articles.title: Anti-monarchy group hands over 'evidence' on Andrew to police and CPS as it calls for investigation
articles.summary: An anti-monarchy campaign group says it has given police and the Crown Prosecution Service "evidence" on Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor.

articles.title: England handed suspended away ticket ban for fans' chants during Spain win
articles.summary: England have been given a suspended away ticket ban by UEFA for "racist and/or discriminatory behaviour" by their fans during a match with Spain in Madrid on Sunday.

articles.title: Ambulance service declares 'critical incident'
articles.summary: London Ambulance Service said it has declared a "critical incident" in response to sustained high demand, with more than 7,000 calls a day over three consecutive days.

articles.title: Boat found off Orkney where fishing boat carrying three men vanished
articles.summary: A partially sunken vessel has been found off the coast of Orkney, weeks after a fishing boat with three people onboard disappeared.
